title: 第2章 初临异世 做人要低调
slug: 魔兽剑圣异界纵横全本免费-魔兽剑圣异界纵横最新章节列表
content_zh:
刘枫把手里刚摘下来的红果，丢在嘴里咕噜的不住咬动，口齿不清的道,“真是倒霉，找了半天就只找到这么几个烂果。”
三下俩口把手中的红果吞进入肚，随手把果核丢在树丛里，用手指剔了剔牙缝，在身上那已经破烂得已经遮不住春guang的衣服上搽了搽，然后继续朝前赶路。
“妈的，刚才真TM的险，差点就成了那条狼的晚餐了，若被吃了，指不定现在是不是变成了一拓大便，给哪颗大树当肥料去了，哈哈，那头狼也是个SB，啧啧，也是少爷智商高，岂是一头畜生能够相比？”想到这里，刘枫狂妄的大笑起来，那嚣张的神情足以让人以为他是否打败了一头巨龙，而不是从一头连阶级都还入的魔兽口中狼狈的逃出升天。
不过，做人不能太狂妄，也不能太嚣张，在地球上某位大神也曾经说过：“做人莫装B，装B糟雷劈”。
虽然刘枫没有真的糟到雷劈，可貌似下场也强不到那里去？
风豹现在很生气，非常的生气，作为这一小片地区的老大，在外围的魔兽平时谁见着，不躲的远远的啊，可今天先是被几个果核砸在头上，又是被一阵刺耳的狂笑从chun梦中惊醒，在梦中，它的梦中情人已经答应了它的求偶，刚正屁颠屁颠的跑过去，准备做那伟大的传宗接代之事，那可恶的笑声就把美梦给打断了，这让它如何不气，如何不怒？
跳出树丛，凭借天生的嗅觉马上找到了这件事情的罪魁祸首，一个丑不拉几，而且还笑得傻不拉几的人类。。。。。
刘枫现在很悲哀，很想哭，“妈的，我怎么就这么背啊，随便丢几个果核都能砸出一头野兽，呜，在地球上每天买彩票，为什么连个安慰奖都从来没有得到过？”
大神教我做人要低调，莫装B，果然真是良言啊，诚不欺我啊。。。。。
风豹并不给正在为自己装B的行为后悔的刘枫机会，头一低，再一抬，一片肉眼可见的青色风刃朝刘枫疾速射去，刘枫连忙趴下身，风刃发出啸声从头顶上飘过，带起一阵凉风，射在了身后的树木上，大树“噶吱”的响了俩下，然后从中断了开去。
刘枫眼直了，特异功能？？？？魔兽？？？？？
爬起身来，转身就跑，妈的，这世界太危险了，还是地球安全啊。。。。
风豹看刘枫逃跑却并不着急，低下头，嘴中不断聚着风元素，猛的，抬头，一大卷风刃，疾射向正在连滚带爬的刘枫。
感到身后传来的劲风，刘枫不敢回头观看，双脚使了命的狂奔，可是腿再快也快不过风，身后的风刃越来越近，刘枫已经听到了身后的风啸声，后背突然一凉，衣服破了。
生死关头，刘枫头脑中一片空白，天地间仿佛安静了下来，身后的呼啸声也停止了，忽然脑海里深处似乎涌出了什么东西，而且似乎自动的启动了？
风豹得意的看着自己的杰作，这是它最强大的招数，“暴风刃”。这魔法可有和人类的四级魔法相媲美。
“暴风刃”离目标越来越近了，风豹嘴角泛起了残忍的微笑。
近了，越来越近了，就在“暴风刃”要将目标撕成碎片之时，那猎物忽然消失了，消失了？
风豹看着这离奇的情况，迷惑的甩了甩头，难道我的魔法升级了？威力变大了，把那个人类撕成了粉末？
不过没有答案，智商并不高的风豹只好把这次的失误归到了魔法突然变强了的原因上，至于为什么变强了么，那多半是那个人类长的太丑，又太嚣张，使得风元素也极其讨厌他的原因吧，管他呢，反正死都死了，回去继续睡觉吧。

话说刘枫当时脑海里的某种东西被启动了，然后，就感觉到周围的景象似乎变的模糊了起来，狂风“呼呼”的不断击打在脸颊上，这似乎是正在高速移动的象征？
猛的，刘枫清醒了过来，这的确是在高速跑动，可我怎么可能跑到这么快？
突然，前方百米远出现一颗巨树，虽然不知道以自己现在的速度撞上去是什么下场，可只要一想起，在地球上高速公路上相撞的汽车，刘枫就头皮发麻。
“停。。呕。。呕。下。。”刘枫一张嘴就被罐入了一肚子的狂风，只能在心底狂吼：“停下，快停下，我草你妈啊，给我停下来啊，劳资不想死啊。”

content_en:
Liu Feng put the red fruit he had just picked in his hand and couldn't help but chew it. He said inarticulately, "It's really unlucky. After searching for a long time, I only found these few rotten fruits."
After swallowing the red fruit in his hands, he threw the core into the bushes, picked the gap between his teeth with his fingers, wiped it on his clothes that were so tattered that they could no longer cover his hair, and then continued to move forward.
"Damn, it was so fucking dangerous just now. It almost became that wolf's dinner. If it was eaten, it might turn into a piece of shit and be used as fertilizer for some big tree. Haha, that wolf is also a SB. Tsk tsk, it's also Young Master Zhi. How can Shang Gao be compared to a beast?" Thinking of this, Liu Feng laughed arrogantly, and his arrogant expression was enough to make people think that he had defeated a giant dragon, instead of escaping from the mouth of a monster that had not even entered the class.
However, you should not be too arrogant or arrogant as a human being. A certain great god on earth once said: "As a human being, don't pretend to be B, as pretending to be B will cause lightning strikes."
Although Liu Feng was not really so bad that he was struck by lightning, it seemed that the outcome was not that bad?
Feng Bao was very angry now, very angry. As the boss of this small area, he usually stayed away from the monsters in the periphery. But today, he was first hit on the head by several fruit cores, and then was knocked out of Chunmeng by a burst of ear-piercing laughter. He woke up in a dream. In his dream, his dream lover had already agreed to his courtship. He just ran over and was about to do the great thing of passing on the family line. That hateful laughter interrupted his sweet dream. How could he not be angry? How could he not be angry?
Jumping out of the bushes, he immediately found the culprit of this matter with his natural sense of smell, a human being who was extremely ugly and had a silly smile. . . . .
Liu Feng is very sad now and wants to cry, "Damn, why do I carry it like this? Just throwing in a few fruit cores can smash out a beast. Wow, I buy lottery tickets every day on earth, why do I never get even a consolation prize?"
The great god taught me to be low-key and not to be pretentious. It was indeed a good advice. You are sincere and don’t deceive me. . . . .
The wind leopard did not give Liu Feng, who was regretting his act of pretending, a chance. He lowered his head, then raised it, and a green blade of wind visible to the naked eye shot towards Liu Feng quickly. Liu Feng quickly lay down, and the wind blade whistled from above his head, bringing with it a gust of cool wind and hitting the trees behind him. The big tree squeaked twice, and then moved away.
Liu Feng's eyes widened. Special power? ? ? ? Warcraft? ? ? ? ?
Get up, turn around and run, damn, this world is too dangerous, but the earth is still safe. . . .
Wind Leopard saw Liu Feng escaping but was not in a hurry. He lowered his head and kept gathering wind elements in his mouth. He raised his head fiercely and fired a large wind blade at Liu Feng who was rolling and crawling.
Feeling the strong wind coming from behind, Liu Feng did not dare to look back and ran as fast as he could, but no matter how fast his legs were, they could not move faster than the wind. The wind blade behind him was getting closer and closer. Liu Feng had already heard the howling wind behind him. Suddenly, his back felt cold and his clothes were torn.
At the critical moment of life and death, Liu Feng's mind went blank. The world seemed to become quiet, and the whistling sound behind him also stopped. Suddenly something seemed to well up from the depths of his mind, and it seemed to start automatically?
Wind Leopard proudly looked at his masterpiece, which was its most powerful move, "Storm Blade". This magic is comparable to human level four magic.
"Storm Blade" was getting closer and closer to the target, and a cruel smile appeared on the corner of Feng Leopard's mouth.
It was getting closer, getting closer, and just when the "Storm Blade" was about to tear the target into pieces, the prey suddenly disappeared. Disappeared?
Feng Bao looked at this bizarre situation and shook his head in confusion. Has my magic been upgraded? The power became stronger, tearing that human into powder?
But there is no answer,Feng Bao, who had a low IQ, had no choice but to attribute this mistake to the sudden increase in magic strength. As for why it became stronger, it was probably because the human was too ugly and too arrogant, which made the wind element hate him extremely. Who cares, he will die anyway, so go back and continue sleeping.
It is said that something in Liu Feng's mind was activated at that time, and then he felt that the surrounding scene seemed to become blurred, and the strong wind kept hitting his cheeks "whooshing". This seemed to be a symbol of high-speed movement?
Suddenly, Liu Feng woke up. He was indeed running at high speed, but how could I run so fast?
Suddenly, a giant tree appeared a hundred meters ahead. Although he didn't know what would happen if he hit it at his current speed, Liu Feng's scalp went numb just thinking about the cars that collided on the highway on Earth.
"Stop... vomit... vomit. Go down..." Liu Feng opened his mouth and was filled with strong wind. He could only roar in his heart: "Stop, stop quickly, I'm going to fuck your mother, stop it, my labor and management don't want to die."
